_doc: Ash's conditions (conditions.gd). conditions.<id>: name, levels [[from strength, name, description]], desc, icon (a drawn glyph: drop, sweat, bolt, heart, sun, snow, dot, or a res:// picture), color, order (badge order), stack (max | add | replace: how a new apply combines), duration {kind: decay (full_minutes: game minutes a full strength lasts) | timer (minutes, refresh) | manual (until: the badge's line)}, left / held (the badge's time line), by_strength (effects scale with strength), effects {speed, stamina_drain, stamina_regen, no_run, blocks_entry}, remark {key, strong_key, strong_at, min, cooldown (game minutes)}: the townspeople's lines are in dialogue.json people.<id>.remarks.<key>. entry.<place>: speaker, voice, open, refuse.<condition> {above, lines, never}; 'default' covers places without their own entry. remarks_per_talk: how many conditions one talk may comment on.

wet.name: Wet
levels: Your shoes and socks are wet from the water. They squelch.
Wet from the water up past the knees. Drying in the air, from the top down.
Soaked through, dripping everywhere. Some places won't let you in like this.

fatigue.name: Fatigued
levels: Out of breath. No running until your stamina is full again.

lines: Whoa, whoa! Ash, you're dripping wet!
The professor has research notes spread all over the floor in here.
Wait outside until you dry off, OK? The sun will sort you out.
Ash Ketchum, you are NOT walking that water through my clean house!
Stand on the porch and drip dry first, sweetie. Then come in and I'll make cocoa.
Oh, dearie, look at you! Not on my good rug.
Wait out on the step till you've dried a bit. I'll put the kettle on.
Flour and puddles make paste, Ash!
Dry off outside first, would you?
You're dripping wet! Wait outside until you dry off.
